tokens.colorNotes: page/paper/brand/ink/subtle/rule/onBrand are used by the shipped ticket layout (TicketEmailHtml.tsx). accentIndigo and accentMint come from the older brand palette (brandColors.ts) and are available for joyful accents; they are not used by the current ticket layout.

type.familyNotes: System fonts only. Custom fonts do not load in most email clients; use an image for hand-lettering.

constraints: Table layout only. No CSS grid or flex, no JavaScript, no web fonts, no SVG images.
Max width 600px; every two-cell row must stay readable at 320px because the layout scales down rather than stacking.
Images are PNG, JPG or GIF hosted at ${WEBAPP_URL}/emails/. Every image needs meaningful alt text.
Nothing essential may live only in an image: images are blocked by default in Outlook and some Gmail setups.
Animated GIF: under about 150 KB, must look right frozen on its first frame (Outlook desktop shows only frame 1), play once and hold.
Dark mode is forced light (color-scheme: light only). Design with opaque backgrounds.
Total email HTML must stay under 100 KB (Gmail clips at 102 KB).
Outlook desktop shows square corners and ignores some padding on links; the design must still read correctly.
Contrast: white on #FF006C is about 4.3:1, so use it only for bold or large text (16px bold or bigger).
Subject lines are unchanged and are not part of this design.

Scalloped top edge. Opaque PNG; the card still reads without it.

Left: big time, duration, timezone. Right: starts-in line (later the countdown image).
2px dotted rule between hero and footer row.
Left caption; right is the Join button when the location is an http(s) link, otherwise the Manage booking caption.
2 columns, 8px gaps, paper background, pink 1px border. An odd last cell spans both columns. Not rendered when there are no actions.
Below a second dotted rule. Holds who, location (when not a link), description, notes, intake answers, price, and apps status for the host.
Confetti over or under the header band. Confirmation email.

states.description: Location is an address or phone number: no Join button, Manage booking caption, location shown in the stub.
120+ character event title, 90 minute event, no intake answers.
All images removed. The card must still read correctly.
The action grid shows 0 to 4 buttons; an odd last one spans both columns. Cover 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.
Stub with no details, or with several intake answers.
Recipient prefers a 24-hour clock: time shows as 09:00.

gif.behaviour: Drawn by the server when the email is opened; ticks about 60 seconds then holds. Also shows the absolute start time. Days and hours only when 48 h or more away; seconds only in the last 2 hours.
gif.limits: Outlook desktop shows only the first frame. Apple Mail Privacy Protection may load the image at delivery, so it can show a stale value; the Open live countdown link goes to a page that always ticks live.
